title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Interest and Insurance 5515 views Q. I am using a credit card from a bank which has tie up with an airlines companey. Whenever I spend any amount from this card I get free milage on jet airways by which I can fly free of charge upto certain miles. My another card has tie up with shoppers stop by which if I spend money I get free points on my card & I can get clothes worth of those many points. Is it OK to take these benifits? I never pay interest or late fee and make payment on time to avaoid paying interest. 2722 views Q. My question is regarding Ribba. I ama government employee. We have to contribute a specific percentage of salary to Provident fund. But most of the employees deposit more than that with the inntentionof saving more. Government gives a fixed rate of interest on this fund for one year. However the rate of interest is fluctuating from year to year depending on the economy of the country. Government is using this money in runing the national affairs of the country and is calculated in the revenue receips in the yearly budget session. I request you to kindly clarify me whether this interest is Lawful according the Islamic Shariah. If not , what should muslim employees do with this interest. What advice would you like (in the light of Quran-o-Sunnah)to this community. Most of the empooyees can not be businessmen, There is no islamic banking system in the country, How could they save their earning from devaluing with the passage of time i.e. If I have one lakh rupees and I deposit it in the bank and do not accept interest after ten years my money will have the valye of onely ten thousand rupees of present time. I hope you may very kindly guide me and my colleagues in the light of Qurano and Sunnah. 2107 views Q. Can we use interest money from bank to pay income tax to government? 9222 views Q. I was not aware of the prohibition of interest and gravity of its "hurmat". I came to Mumbai from Lucknow and started working in a Call Centre, I did not have my own house so I bought one by taking loan from a Bank. Now I realise the ill effects and evil of interest, I want to sell off that house and get rid of interest. I paid approximately Rs.1,30,000 out of my own pocket and got a loan of Rs.6,80,000, the house cost in all approximately Rs.8,10,000. Now I want to sell off that house, it may fetch around Rs.13 lakhs today. I want to know how much can I keep and how much will be the interest which I should not use. Please let me know out of the sale price how much will be HALAL for me and what percentage will be HARAM for me? Also let me know what could be the possible ways of disposing the HARAM amount. 1761 views Q. income tax and bank interst 2799 views Q. Construction Masjid Toilet 2080 views Q. My name is Ajaz Ahmed and I am from Kashmir. I want to set up Islamic loan facility for Muslim brothers 2031 views Q. I made a house by bank loan. The bank will take EMI for a long period so nowadays what can I do? 2781 views Q. Helping the elders in getting the interest 1496 views Q. If I borrow 25000 on interest and I will have to pay 5000 as interest. I also have 1,00,000 separately. Will all of 1,25,000 become haram? Or just 25,000? Or all of the money will remain halal but I will be punished for this great sin? 2135 views Q. Using Interest for availing banking services 6539 views Q. Claim of Health Insurance 9459 views Q. I intend buying a car using the islamic financing where the bank buys the car and they sell it to you at a profit but where iam not comfortable is that the bank insists i should get a comprehansive insurance which i do not want iam prepared to get the ordinary 3 rd party insurance which is compulsory by law.i feel the bank is protecting there interest but is this allowed? Can i go ahead and get comprehensive insurance as without that they do not sell me the car. 2230 views Q. The bank account of the masjid has earned some interest. My question is that what is the legal procedure of the said interest? 3157 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 1321 Country: AU Title: Question: AA, I am living in Australia with my family,we are living in a rent house and the house ower did the 6 months agrement with us we don't konw wether he give notice to leave the house after 6 months or not but if he will give us notice then its very defficult to find place on rent now a days its a big probblem here,people spend 2 or3 months to find a place on rent. please tell me in this circumstances if I take laon and buy a house and after spend three years and sell it again and it gose on its own price or get profit. and i take this money with me to my contry . IS IT CORRECT IN ISLAM TO GIVE INTERST ON LAON IN THIS DIFFICULT SATUATION AND WHEN SELL THIS HOUSE TAKING PROFIT IS CORRECT? Answer ID: 1321 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 888/833=B) If there is really problem in regard to the house and you fear dishonour in case the house owner gives notice to you. So, in this condition, it will be allowable for you to take loan only as much as necessary to build house in order to protect your honour. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
